title: Looking up exports

milestone.title: Ground Rules, Tools and the PE Format

hints: Three small readers make this short: a 4-byte number, a 2-byte number, and a zero-terminated string at an RVA. The functions array is at the RVA stored at +28, so function `i` is the 4 bytes at `that + 4 * i`.
For the binary search, keep a range `[lo, hi)` of positions in the names array. `std::string_view::compare` gives the same ordering as `strcmp`.
